'''Clausura 2018''':
{{nowrap|7 January – 20 May{{cite web|last1=Molina Salas|first1=José Pablo|title=UNAFUT presentó el calendario del Campeonato Clausura 2018|url=http://www.unafut.com/site/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=5795:unafut-presento-el-calendario-del-campeonato-clausura-2018&catid=6:noticias&Itemid=40|website=www.unafut.com|publisher=[[Liga FPD|UNAFUT]]|access-date=27 September 2017|language=es-es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170928005736/http://www.unafut.com/site/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=5795:unafut-presento-el-calendario-del-campeonato-clausura-2018&catid=6:noticias&Itemid=40|archive-date=28 September 2017|url-status=dead}}}} | winner = | continentalcup1qualifiers = | continentalcup2qualifiers = | matches footnote = | total goals footnote = | best player = | best goalkeeper = }} The '''2017–18 [[Liga FPD]]''' season, also known as '''Campeonato Banco Popular''' for sponsorship reasons, is the 97th since its establishment. The tournament is the first since the [[2006–07 Primera División (Costa Rica)|2006–07 season]] to use the Apertura and Clausura names to their short tournaments, marking a departure from the Invierno and Verano tournaments.{{cite web|last1=Coto|first1=Gerardo|title=Los torneos de Apertura vuelven al fútbol nacional|url=http://www.unafut.com/site/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=5729:los-torneos-de-apertura-vuelven-al-futbol-nacional&catid=9:noticias-historicas&Itemid=49|website=UNAFUT.com|publisher=[[Liga FPD|UNAFUT]]|access-date=29 July 2017|language=es-es|date=25 July 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170729134824/http://www.unafut.com/site/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=5729:los-torneos-de-apertura-vuelven-al-futbol-nacional&catid=9:noticias-historicas&Itemid=49|archive-date=29 July 2017|url-status=dead}} The [[Voit]] Lummo is the official match ball of the tournament.{{cite news|last1=Molina|first1=José Pablo|title=El Campeón abre en Guadalupe {{!}} El Guardián.cr|url=http://elguardian.cr/deportes/el-campeon-abre-en-guadalupe/|access-date=23 June 2017|work=El Guardián (Costa Rica)|date=20 June 2017|language=es-ES}}{{Dead link|date=June 2022 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} [[C.S. Herediano|Herediano]] entered as the defending champions, but lost the title in the Apertura finals to [[A.D. Municipal Pérez Zeledón|Pérez Zeledón]]. ==Teams== Twelve teams contested for the league title; ten sides from the [[2016–17 Liga FPD|2016–17 season]], one team promoted from the [[Segunda División de Costa Rica|Liga de Ascenso]] and a newly formed team. [[Municipal Grecia|Grecia]] were promoted for their debut in the Liga FPD after defeating Jicaral in the Liga de Ascenso final, thus replacing [[A.D. San Carlos|San Carlos]] in the Liga FPD.{{cite news|last1=Masís|first1=Fiorella|last2=Jiménez|first2=Daniel|title=Grecia asciende a Primera División de la mano de Paté Centeno|url=http://www.nacion.com/deportes/futbol-costa-rica/Municipal_Grecia-Jicaral_Sercoba-Liga_de_Ascenso_0_1636436412.html|access-date=29 May 2017|work=[[La Nación (San José)|La Nación]]|date=28 May 2017|language=es}} [[Guadalupe F.C.|Guadalupe]] is a newly established team that take over the previous franchise of [[Belén F.C.|Belén]].{{cite news|last1=Mendoza|first1=Adrián|title=Belén desaparece para dar paso a Guadalupe FC|url=https://www.crhoy.com/deportes/belen-desaparece-para-dar-paso-a-guadalupe-fc/|access-date=29 May 2017|work=CRHoy|date=26 May 2017|language=es-ES}} UNAFUT authorized the name change just two days before the beginning of the season.{{cite news|last1=Jiménez|first1=Daniel|title=Guadalupe FC recibe aval para cambio de nombre en la Unafut|url=http://www.nacion.com/deportes/futbol-costa-rica/Guadalupe-FC-recibe-nombre-Unafut_0_1648435225.html|access-date=29 July 2017|work=[[La Nación (San José)|La Nación]]|date=27 July 2017|language=es}} On 2 June 2017 Henning Jensen, rector of the [[University of Costa Rica]], announced the cease of the agreement between the university and its [[C.F. Universidad de Costa Rica|homonymous club]], citing that the transfer of the administrative management of the team to the Colombian company Con Talla Mundial was neither requested nor advised to the university. Jensen also stated that the club did not comply with the correction in the financial part of the club.{{cite news|last1=Córdoba|first1=Javier|title=UCR acaba vínculo con equipo de fútbol de primera división|url=http://semanariouniversidad.ucr.cr/deportes/ucr-acaba-vinculo-equipo-futbol-primera-division/|access-date=4 June 2017|work=[[University of Costa Rica|Semanario Universidad]]|date=2 June 2017|language=es-ES|archive-date=2 June 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170602233927/http://semanariouniversidad.ucr.cr/deportes/ucr-acaba-vinculo-equipo-futbol-primera-division/|url-status=dead}} On 19 June 2017, Con Talla Mundial announced that the club will now be under the name "Universitarios FC".{{cite news|last1=Oviedo|first1=Steven|title=Equipo de la UCR cambia de nombre, anuncia la llegada de 17 jugadores y nuevo cuerpo técnico|url=http://www.nacion.com/deportes/futbol-costa-rica/UCR-anuncia-llegada-jugadores-tecnico_0_1640835996.html|access-date=20 June 2017|work=[[La Nación (San José)|La Nación]]|date=19 June 2017|language=es}} The administration of the team had revealed the team badge and their intentions to use the [[Estadio Nacional de Costa Rica (2011)|Estadio Nacional]] as their home stadium.{{cite news|last1=Segura|first1=Geovanny|title=Universitarios FC buscará el Estadio Nacional como su sede para este torneo|url=https://www.laprensalibre.cr/Noticias/detalle/114971/universitarios-fc-buscara-el-estadio-nacional-como-su-sede-para-este-torneo|access-date=17 July 2017|work=La Prensa Libre|date=22 June 2017|archive-date=30 June 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170630091517/http://www.laprensalibre.cr/Noticias/detalle/114971/universitarios-fc-buscara-el-estadio-nacional-como-su-sede-para-este-torneo|url-status=dead}} However, the Asociación Filial Club de Fútbol UCR, which holds the rights of the team within the league, sued the University because of their cease of the agreement. The club then retains its original name and is due to return to the Estadio Ecológico.{{cite news|last1=Tayver|first1=Fanny|title=Equipo de fútbol sigue llamándose UCR y hasta regresa al Estadio Ecológico|url=http://www.nacion.com/deportes/futbol-costa-rica/UCR-Universitarios_FC-Apertura_2017_0_1644435579.html|access-date=17 July 2017|work=[[La Nación (San José)|La Nación]]|date=7 July 2017|language=es}} ===Stadia and locations=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" ! Universidad de Costa Rica|UCR]] |position=bottom}} }} ==Torneo Apertura== {{Main|2017–18 Liga FPD – Apertura season}} The Apertura tournament will be played in the second half of 2017, starting on 29 July and, given the possibility of a final, ending on 23 December. The tournament is dedicated to former referee [[Luis Paulino Siles]] who, in [[1982 FIFA World Cup|1982]], became the first Costa Rican to officiate a match at a [[FIFA World Cup]].{{cite web|last1=Coto|first1=Gerardo|title=Primer silbatero mundialista de Costa Rica será el dedicado del Apertura|url=http://www.unafut.com/site/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=5727:primer-silbatero-mundialista-de-costa-rica-sera-el-dedicado-del-apertura&catid=9:noticias-historicas&Itemid=49|website=UNAFUT.com|publisher=[[Liga FPD|UNAFUT]]|access-date=29 July 2017|language=es-es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170729133102/http://www.unafut.com/site/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=5727:primer-silbatero-mundialista-de-costa-rica-sera-el-dedicado-del-apertura&catid=9:noticias-historicas&Itemid=49|archive-date=29 July 2017|url-status=dead}} The tournament began with two scoreless draws in the [[CF Universidad de Costa Rica|UCR]] vs [[C.S. Cartaginés|Cartaginés]] and [[C.S. Herediano|Herediano]] vs [[Guadalupe F.C.|Guadalupe]] matches. [[Deportivo Saprissa|Saprissa]]'s Luis Stewart Pérez scored the first goal of the tournament, during his team's match against [[A.D. Carmelita|Carmelita]].{{cite news|last1=Álvarez|first1=Cristian|title=Luis Stewart Pérez anotó el primer gol del Apertura 2017|url=http://www.elpais.cr/2017/07/30/luis-stewart-perez-anoto-el-primer-gol-del-apertura-2017/|access-date=30 July 2017|work=Diario Digital Nuestro País|date=30 July 2017}} ===Regular season=== Defending champions [[C.S. Herediano|Herediano]] topped the season undefeated with 54 points. By achieving this, Herediano broke two records in the league. They became the first team with the longest undefeated streak (surpassing the 21-match streak by [[Deportivo Saprissa|Saprissa]] in the 2003–04 season, the team being coincidentally managed by [[Hernán Medford]]). The team also broke the record for more points achieved in a regular season, surpassing [[Liga Deportiva Alajuelense|Alajuelense]] in the [[2014–15 Liga FPD#Campeonato de Invierno|2014 Invierno season]].{{cite news|last1=Brenes|first1=Cristian|title=Herediano impone récords aplastando dentro y fuera de casa|url=http://www.nacion.com/puro-deporte/futbol-nacional/herediano-impone-records-aplastando-dentro-y-fuera/D4XHD2EOVVEA3A2Q3ZZK2KN5HI/story/|access-date=22 November 2017|work=[[La Nación (San José)|La Nación]]|date=21 November 2017|language=es-LA}} On 3 September 2017, the match between [[Deportivo Saprissa|Saprissa]] and [[Municipal Grecia|Grecia]] was suspended at the 81st minute due to a false bomb threat.{{cite news|last1=Álvarez|first1=Cristian|title=El partido Saprissa-Grecia fue suspendido por una falsa amenaza de bomba|url=https://www.elpais.cr/2017/09/03/el-partido-saprissa-grecia-fue-suspendido-por-una-amenaza-de-bomba/|access-date=18 December 2017|work=Diario Digital Nuestro País|date=3 September 2017|language=es-ES}} The remaining nine minutes were played the next morning.{{cite web|title=Comunicado Oficial: Evacuación del estadio Ricardo Saprissa|url=http://unafut.com/web/index.php/clubes/deportivo-saprissa/29-comunicado-oficial-evacuacion-del-estadio-ricardo-saprissa|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171218000806/http://unafut.com/web/index.php/clubes/deportivo-saprissa/29-comunicado-oficial-evacuacion-del-estadio-ricardo-saprissa|url-status=dead|archive-date=18 December 2017|website=UNAFUT.com|access-date=18 December 2017|date=18 December 2017}} ====Standings==== {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |res_col_header=Q |team1=HER|name_HER=[[C.S.
